capabilities: Search Library of Congress Subject Headings with fuzzy matching
Insert a heading as YAML frontmatter or inline YAML at the selection
Add subdivisions to build complex subjects like Phonecians--Religion
Show broader, narrower, related headings, variant labels and LC Classification
Open the authorized heading on the Library of Congress website
disambiguation: Not a general linked-data or semantic-web tool; it currently supports only Library of Congress Subject Headings.
extras: Warns that inserting YAML overwrites existing key values and removes unused key names, so key names should be fixed up front. Existing users below version 1.0.0 must migrate data via the Linked Data Helper plugin. Loading suggester data on startup is discouraged on mobile; syncing via Obsidian Sync requires enabling 'Sync all other types'.
problem: Obsidian has no way to attach controlled-vocabulary subject headings from a library authority file, so topic metadata relies on free-form tags.

relations.evidence: To generate the necessary data, you have to install the Linked Data Helper plugin
Use this plugin with Breadcrumbs. You can set the hierachies in its settings
inserting it as inline YAML at the current selection for use with Dataview

summary: Plugin that adds Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) as YAML metadata to notes, with hierarchy links and subdivision support.
